comments.text: I kept thinking about how much daily life revolves around family, faith, and community. Seeing that side of Saudi Arabia felt much more personal than the usual headlines.

comments.text: Living in Saudi Arabia 🇸🇦✨ — where ancient traditions, breathtaking deserts, modern cities, and rich culture come together in one incredible place. What a fascinating country to explore! 🌴🏜️❤️
